BiblicalUsage: 1) to be hot, become warm; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be or grow warm; 1a2) of passion (fig.); 1b) (Niphal) to become aroused, inflame oneself with; 1c) (Piel) to warm; 1d) (Hithpael) to warm oneself
